meta.name: NOS4A2 720p
meta.description: A young Victoria "Vic" McQueen discovers she has the power to unlock portals that help her find lost objects. As she delves further into this hidden universe, she encounters many other "inscape travelers" - some benevolent, and some who have been corrupted by their power. When Vic encounters Charlie Manx, an immortal who stays that way by feeding off of the souls of children, she makes a sworn enemy of Manx.

videos.title: The Shorter Way
videos.overview: Vic, a young New Englander, discovers her supernatural abilities as the immortal Charlie Manx lures a child into a mysterious Rolls Royce Wraith.

videos.title: The Gas Mask Man
videos.overview: Vic strives to live a normal life despite Maggie's warning. Charlie Manx puts Bing Partridge to work.

videos.title: The House of Sleep
videos.overview: Vic seeks the Wraith and learns she must trust her gift. A body surfaces in Haverhill.

videos.title: The Wraith
videos.overview: Vic is questioned by the police and cannot fill the holes in her story. Manx lays out his plan for Vic, but things go awry.

videos.title: The Dark Tunnels
videos.overview: Vic meets another strong creative who gives her some advice. Manx receives an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Scissors for the Drifter
videos.overview: Vic finds herself trapped. Manx runs into trouble and calls Bing for help.

videos.title: Parnassus
videos.overview: Vic finds herself in danger after an argument with Linda. Manx seeks advice from an old friend.

videos.title: Sleigh House
videos.overview: Despite Maggie's warning, Vic strives to rescue a loved one. Manx learns something new about Vic

videos.title: Gunbarrel
videos.overview: Vic enlists a local biker to help her try to stop Charlie Manx. Manx makes a pitstop on his way to Christmasland.

videos.title: Bad Mother
videos.overview: Eight years on, Vic McQueen receives shocking news about Charlie Manx. Maggie consults her tiles at great risk. Bing hunts down the Wraith, but hits a roadblock. Millie Manx discovers a new aspect of Christmasland.

videos.title: Good Father
videos.overview: Charlie Manx fights for his life. Millie Manx determines to never let the lights go out in Christmasland again. Bing receives a long awaited call. Wayne McQueen, attempting to understand his mother, walks headlong into danger.

videos.title: The Night Road
videos.overview: Vic McQueen takes the Shorter Way to Haverhill. Lou and Wayne face a terrible threat in her absence. Charlie Manx engages an old friend for a mysterious favor. Millie Manx confronts the past.

videos.title: The Lake House
videos.overview: With Charlie Manx on the hunt, Vic and her family go into hiding with Maggie. Wayne suffers mysterious nightmares while Tabitha chases a lead on Bing.

videos.title: Bruce Wayne McQueen
videos.overview: Vic McQueen returns to the Lakehouse only to ride straight into a deadly trap; Charlie Manx cashes in his favor; the Hourglass Man, a powerful strong creative, appears.

videos.title: The Hourglass
videos.overview: Maggie puts herself in danger attempting to take a dark strong creative off the board; Vic and Lou work to repair Vic's knife; Linda and Chris grapple with Vic's gift; Wayne makes a mysterious friend.

videos.title: Cripple Creek
videos.overview: Bing Partridge has some questions for Charlie Manx. Manx revisits his difficult childhood. Millie meets an old friend. Wayne is put to a choice.

videos.title: Chris McQueen
videos.overview: Vic and Chris take the Shorter Way to a junkyard. Chris loses his temper. Bing leverages a secret to seek forgiveness. Vic, Lou, Maggie and Chris hatch a plan. Tabitha impresses her boss.

videos.title: Welcome to Christmasland
videos.overview: Vic and Maggie embark on a dangerous journey. Charlie Manx confronts his deepest fears. As her world falls apart, Millie must choose between freedom and her father.

videos.title: Bats
videos.overview: Vic McQueen makes her final stand against Charlie Manx. Lou and Tabitha solve a Christmasland riddle. Millie Manx wrestles with regret.
